content: Yerusalaame Shiiquwa
Issi issi asati Yihudape Anxooke bidi, “Muse wogaatho hinte qaxaretonna ixiko attanaw danda7eketa” gidi ammaneyisata tamaarso doomidosona.

Hessi Phawuloosanne Barnabaasa entara daro palamanadanne kaccanaada oothis. Hessa gisho, Anxooken de7iya issi issi asati Phawuloosaranne Barnabaasara Yerusalaame bidi Hawaaretaranne cimatara gahetidi he oda billanaw qofay qashetis.
Woosa keethay enta kiittin bidosona. Enti Sirofinqe Samaarera aadhishe Ayhude gidonnaysati Xoossako waanidi simmidaako odidosona. Hessi ammaneyisata ubbaa daro ufaysis.
Enti Yerusalaame gakida wode woosa keethay, Hawaaretinne cimati enta mokidosona. Xoossay bantara oothidaba ubba odidosona.
Shin Farsaaweta baggafe ammanida issi issi asati dendi eqidi, “Ayhude gidonashin ammanida asati qaxaretanawunne Muse higge naaganaw bessees” yaagidosona.
Hawaaretinne cimati hessa zorettanaw shiiqidosona.
Daro zoretidaape guye, Phexroosi dendi eqidi, “Ta ishato, Ayhude gidonnaysati Wongela qaala ta doonape si7idi ammanana mela kasetidi tana Xoossay hinte giddofe dooridaysa hinte ereeta.
Asa wozana eriya Xoossay Geeshsha Ayyaana nuus immidaysada entawuka immidi tumayis.
Ammanon enta wozana geeshshida gisho nu giddoninne enta giddon dummatethi wothibeenna.
Hessa gisho, nu aawatinne nuuni tookanaw danda7iboona qambara ammaneyisata morgen wothidi ha77i ayis hinte Xoossa paacetii?
Godaa Yesuus Kiristoosa aadho keehatethan enti attidaysada nuka attidaysa ammanoos” yaagis.
Asay si77i gidi, Barnabaasinne Phawuloosi Ayhude gidonna asaa giddon banta baggara Xoossay oothida malaatatanne oorathaba ubbaa odishin si7oosona.
Enti haasaya ongidaape guye Yayqoobi, “Ishato, ta geysa si7ite.
Xoossay Ayhude gidonnayisata giddofe ba ase dooranaw koyidi entana koyro waatidi qopidaako Simooni odis.
Nabeta qaalay haysara issino. Geeshsha Maxaafan,

content.text: taani xeegida Ayhude gidonna asa ubbay tana koyana.
Benipe doomada hessi eretana mela oothida

content: “Hessa gisho, ta qofay Xoossako simmiya Ayhude gidonnayisata nuuni waaysonaako lo77o.
Shin enti eeqas yarshetidi tunidaba moonna mela, laymatonna mela, bawuta moonna melanne suuthi uyonna mela entaw nuuni dabdaabe xaafanaw koshshees.
Muse higgey benipe doomidi Sambaatan Sambaatan ayhude woosa keethatan nabbabetishe katama ubban sabbaketees” yaagis.

Hessafe guye, hawaaretinne cimati woosa keetha asa ubbaara issife banta giddofe guutha asata dooridi Phawuloosaranne Barnabaasara Anxooke yeddanaw qofa qachidosona. Enti daro bonchetida nam7u asata Barsabaasa geetetiya Yihudanne Sillaase dooridosona.
Haysada geetetidi xaafetida dabdaabe enta bolla yeddidosona: “Nuuni hawaaretinne cimati hinte ishati, Anxooken, Sooreninne Kilqen de7iya Ayhude gidonna ishatas nu sarothuwa kiittoos.
“Nuuni kiittonna asati nu giddofe bidi, ‘Hinte qaxaretanawunne higgiya naaganaw bessees’ gidi, hintena waaysidaysanne yiloydaysa si7ida.
Nuuni dosiya Barnabaasanne Phawuloosa dooretida asatara issife hinteko kiittanaw issi wozanan nu qofaa qachida.
Enti nu Godaa Yesuus Kiristoosa gisho banta de7uwa aathidi immidosona.
Hessa gisho, nuuni xaafidaysa enti banta doonan gujidi hintew odana mela Yihudanne Sillaase kiitida.
“Ha koshsheysatape attishin, hara tooho hintena toossonna mela nunne Geeshsha Ayyaanay oda qachida.
Eeqas yarshetidi tunidaba moopite, suuthu uyopite, bawuta moopite, laymatopite. Ha ubbaafe hinte huuphiya naagiko hinte lo77oba ootheeta. Hiza, saro de7ite” yaagidosona.
Hessa gisho, kiitetidaysati moyzetidi Anxooke bidi ammaniya asaa shiishidi, dabdaabe immidosona.
Enti he minthethiya dabdaabiya nabbabida wode ufaytidosona.
Qassi Yihudinne Sillaasey banta huuphen nabe gidiya gisho ammaneyisata loythi zoridi minthethidosona.
Enti Anxooken guutha gallas uttidaape guye ishati lo77ora moyzin bantana kiitidaysatako simmidosona.
[Shin Sillaasey yan attanaw koyis].
Qassi Phawuloosinne Barnabaasi hara daro asatara issife Godaa qaala tamaarsishenne wongelaa odishe Anxooken gam7idosona.
Phawuloosanne Barnabaasa Shaaketetha
Guutha gallasape guye Phawuloosi Barnabaasako, “Nuuni Godaa qaala odida katama ubban ammaneysati waanidi de7iyako guye simmishe xomoosi be7oos” yaagis.
Barnabaasi Marqoosa geetetiya Yohaanisa bantara efanaw koyis.
Shin Phawuloosi Marqoosa bantara efanaw koybeenna. Gaasoyka, I Phinfilen shaaketidi entara oothanaw bibeenna.
Enta giddon iita ooshshi keyin issoy issuwafe shaaketidosona. Barnabaasi Marqoosa ekidi markabera Qophiroosa bis.
Shin Phawuloosi Sillaase dooris; ammaneysati Phawuloosa Xoossa aadho keehatethas hadara immidaape guye, I keyidi bis.
Yaatidi, woosa keethata minthethishe Sooreranne Kilqiyara aadhis.
